reported.quote: We had a growth of 3.1% for the full year in constant currency terms.
Our Q4 revenue growth was 4.1% year-on-year in constant currency terms.
For the full year, we had $14.9 bn of large deals. This is a growth of 28 % over the prior year.
And for Q4, we were at $3.2 bn, a strong showing for the quarter.
Financial Services for FY26 grew above company average at 4.4% , led by ramp-ups of large deal wins
Adjusted operating margin was stable at 21%.
Q4 operating margins stood at 20.9%, down 0.3% sequentially, adjusted for the Labor Code impact in Q3.

guidance.quote: Our revenue growth guidance for the financial year 2027 is 1.5% to 3.5% growth year -on-year in constant currency terms.
